region_reference.description: Initial Frostreach/Ice Wall Gate regional concept image.

workflow_notes: The simple outline TMX is the gameplay/layout source of truth.
The final playable level should be map.tmx.
PaintedGround is visual only; collisions/effects/spawners remain authored by normal TMX layers.
A second polish pass can reuse the same chunk grid and write a new generated/painted output folder before replacing map.tmx.
Seam repair passes live under the seam_pass_root and keep backups before updating canonical painted chunks and map.tmx.
